messages:
morgan: Heads-up — PR #8429 (prefill/kv-shard tweak) triggered a sporadic p95 spike on canary last night. attaching a couple of sampled traces and a histogram. can someone from runtime or oncall take a quick look? :eyes:
sre-bot: ALERT: canary p95 latency +250ms at 2026-03-17T03:12Z — alert: https://alerts.redwood/incidents/8429-canary-p95
evans: I'm on it. can you link the bench artifacts and the compare output?
morgan: uploaded artifacts to s3: s3://redwood-artifacts/pr-8429/bench-20260317.tar.gz and bench compare: https://bench.redwood/compare/pr-8429-vs-main
morgan: quick local compare snippet:
```
$ ./tools/bench compare --baseline=main --candidate=pr-8429 --metric=p95
workload    baseline(ms)   candidate(ms)   delta
longseq     420            660             +240ms
small-batch 48             50              +2ms
```
ryan: that delta on longseq screams prefill change. PR touched gc/prefill and kv shard hotpath. I pulled a flame and saw alloc churn around token 1024: https://perf.redwood/alloc/trace/abcd
evans: noted. can you paste the exact diff hunk?
morgan: diff: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/8429/files#diff-23a4 - it's two lines in allocator prefill where we changed the eager sizing heuristics
jordan: oncall recs? revert immediately or add fallback?
sam: oncall here — pause the canary and switch to fallback model variant for traffic. I'll pause rollout in console now.
sam: paused canary at 2026-03-17T03:58Z and switched routing to model-v2-fallback.
evans: I'll prepare a revert PR that restores the previous prefill heuristic. putting up a patch under PR #8429-revert. can someone give a quick +1 so I can push?
ryan: I can +1 the revert, but evan should run a quick microbench against 4k/longseq before we merge. queueing a run: https://ci.redwood/job/bench-pr-8429/1
evans: queued. results posted: p95 jump reproduced on longseq, other workloads flat. link: https://ci.redwood/job/bench-pr-8429/1/artifacts/histogram.png
morgan: added notes to PR about follow-up investigations (kv-shard reorder, alloc sizing tests), and tagged infra and perf for a deeper postmortem.
ryan: +1 on revert. we should also add a unit test that exercises prefill path at boundary token lengths.
evans: agree. adding test and will open a follow-up PR after revert.
morgan: thanks all. I'll update the incident thread with the rollback and attach the bench artifacts for audit. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: DEPLOYMENT: canary rollout paused for pr-8429 at 2026-03-17T04:00Z (action by sam).
morgan: leaving this thread for async handoff — if anyone notices new anomalies ping here.
